mission.heading: The Fall of Eldoria
paras: Eldoria was the last great kingdom of the West. It was ruled from the Ashen Throne and held together by five great hosts.
On the night called Ashfall, the gates opened, the beacons stayed dark, and the Hollow King's frost came through. Eldoria has been frozen ever since.
You are Elowen, last heir of House Valorin. Win back the five hosts and reach the Ashen Throne before the Long Winter closes. You have ten minutes.

tutorial.title: Look around
tutorial.text: Drag to turn and look in every direction.

tutorial.title: Tap what glows
tutorial.text: Glowing spots can be opened, read or used. Some can be turned in your hands.

tutorial.title: The Book
tutorial.text: Everything you learn goes into your Book. Open it any time.

tutorial.title: Panels
tutorial.text: Puzzles open in panels. Use X to close one. Use Pause to stop the clock.

tutorial.title: Clock, Renown and hints
tutorial.text: You have 10 minutes. Finds earn Renown. Wrong answers and hints cost Renown. You get 3 hints. Brann says them out loud. The clock keeps running.

open.1.t: Elowen, if you can read this, you are at the Gate of Eldoria. The five hosts are still waiting beyond it. They have not forgotten the sun.

open.2.t: Waiting? The gate is shut, the statues have no faces, and my beard is freezing. I like it already.

open.3.t: Four kings guard this gate. Their shields will open it, if we read them right.

open.4.t: Of course there is a riddle. There is always a riddle.

idle.t: Try turning around. Drag to look around.

hint.none.t: No more hints left. You can do this.

r1.enter.1.t: I played under these kings when I was a child.

r1.enter.2.t: Now they have no faces. Lovely.

r1.inspect.aldric.t: Aldric the Bold. His shield shows a lion.

r1.inspect.berenor.t: Berenor the Wise. His shield shows an oak tree.

r1.inspect.cadoc.t: Cadoc the Just. His shield shows a mountain.

r1.inspect.doreth.t: Doreth the Swift. His shield shows a hawk.

r1.wrong.1.t: It did not fit. Maybe the order matters.

r1.wrong.2.t: Read the plaque. Then look at each king's shield.

r1.wrong.3.t: Aldric is first. Doreth is last. Cadoc comes after Berenor.

r1.hint.t: Each statue has a name and a shield. The plaque says who came first and who came last.

r1.right.1.t: Lion, oak, mountain, hawk. The four kings, in their order.

r1.right.2.t: And look, Elowen. The bar was lifted, not broken. Someone inside opened this gate.

r1.oath.t: The Guard held the walls, as we swore. We stand with you.

r2.enter.1.t: No one has crossed these stones since Ashfall.

r2.enter.2.t: Something is watching us from the branches. Many somethings.

r2.wrong.1.t: The roots snapped back. Try a different path.

r2.wrong.2.t: Four trees, four carved rules. Have you read them all?

r2.wrong.3.t: Start on a leaf and end on a star. No thorns. No stone like the one you leave. Never lean the same way twice.

r2.hint.t: The tree rules are the key. Cross out every thorn first.

r2.right.1.t: From a leaf to a star, and never the same lean twice. The Wood let us through.

r2.right.2.t: And that cold lantern is no accident.

r2.oath.t: No beacon burned that night. We saw only darkness. The Aelari stand with you.

r3.enter.1.t: Ironroot Deeps. The forge is still warm.

r3.enter.3.t: Valorin. Fill my order exactly, with the ore I have, and I will listen.

r3.wrong.1.t: He weighed it. Too much ore, or too little. Count again.

r3.wrong.2.t: Read the slate and the four recipes. The slate has a rule about fine swords.

r3.wrong.3.t: Four swords, three shields, every bar used, and at least three swords fine.

r3.hint.t: Add up what each recipe uses. Then match the total to the bins.

r3.right.1.t: One plain sword and three fine. One plain shield and two banded. Not one bar left.

r3.right.2.t: Dwarves are happiest when the numbers are perfect.

r3.oath.t: That night, the royal armory was opened with a key. No door was forced. Ironroot stands with you.

r4.enter.1.t: Four lords, four chairs, and not one friend among them.

r4.enter.2.t: They agree on nothing. So they will not agree on you.

r4.wrong.orne.t: You do not understand what is coming.

r4.wrong.keyes.t: Where is the profit in that?

r4.wrong.crane.t: I know my duty. You do not know me.

r4.wrong.1.t: That did not move them. Think about what each lord cares about.

r4.wrong.2.t: Look at what stands around each lord. A room shows what a person wants.

r4.wrong.3.t: Pride, fear, money and duty. Each lord cares about one of them. Pick the line that fits.

r4.hint.t: Look at the thing near each lord. Then pick the line that fits what that lord cares about.

r4.won.venn.t: My name above the throne? Done.

r4.won.keyes.t: Ten years with no tax? Ravenspire is yours.

r4.won.crane.t: My oath still stands. So does Ravenspire.

r4.right.1.t: Four lords, four reasons, one yes.

r4.right.2.t: I should learn to read a room like that.

r4.oath.t: A raven told the north to stand down at the eighth bell. Ravenspire will find who sent it. Our ravens are yours.

r5.enter.1.t: Stormwatch. The wall that was never meant to fall.

r5.enter.2.t: It looks like it fell once already.

r5.enter.3.t: Valorin? Good. I have forty tired people and a raven that says the enemy is coming.

r5.wavestart.t: Read the raven's report. Then build.

r5.leak.1.t: They broke through. Check what is coming before you build.

r5.leak.2.t: The raven tells you the side and the enemy. Match your defenders to them.

r5.leak.3.t: Oil for swarms, ballistae for trolls, archers for flyers.

r5.hint.t: Read the raven and the board. Each enemy has one best defender.

r5.right.1.t: Both waves are beaten, and the wall held.

r5.right.2.t: The dwarves will be unbearable about their bolts.

r5.oath.t: The watch was called to the feast hall at sundown. No one stood on this wall when the frost came. Stormvale rides with you.

r6.enter.1.t: My father's war room. He planned every march from this table.

r6.enter.2.t: And the map is in six pieces. Of course it is.

r6.enter.3.t: Five hosts, one dawn. March them so they all arrive together.

r6.wrong.1.t: The pegs said no. Some host would be early or late.

r6.wrong.2.t: Read the road lengths on the map. Then read the speeds in the notes.

r6.wrong.3.t: Days on the road equal leagues divided by speed. Everyone must arrive on Day 7.

r6.hint.t: Work out how many days each host needs. The longest road leaves first.

r6.right.1.t: Six days for the north, then four, three, two and one. Five hosts, one dawn.

r6.right.2.t: Remind me never to argue with your father's maps.

r6.marshal.t: The order to hold the north pass was cancelled with the king's own seal. I was still holding it when they found me.

r7.enter.1.t: The Throne Court. Seven kings of my line, all watching.

r7.enter.2.t: Please let none of them be angry.

r7.s1.start.t: The wyrm answers the song of the five hosts. Tap the glowing horn. Then play the six notes from your Book.

r7.s1.wrong.1.t: That was not the song. Look in your Book.

r7.s1.wrong.2.t: Six notes, one from each room. They are on the Horn Song page.

r7.s1.wrong.3.t: High, low, low... the rest is in your Book.

r7.s2.start.t: Five things happened on Ashfall night. Test each one on the three suspects. Who could do all five?

r7.s2.wrong.1.t: That person could not do everything. Test every clue first.

r7.s2.wrong.2.t: Look at the ticks and crosses. Only one person has a tick every time.

r7.s2.wrong.3.t: Count the ticks. Who has all five?

r7.s2.right.t: You were never meant to read the whole record, girl.

r7.s3.start.t: Frost spirits! Follow the arrow and tap them. Vyrmrath will burn each one.

r7.s3.wrong.t: Wrong banner! Think about what each host is good at.

r7.s3.face.t: Turn to face the glow first.

r7.hint.s1.t: The song is in your Book, one note from each room.

r7.hint.s2.t: Test each clue. Who has a tick on all five?

r7.hint.s3.t: Follow the arrow and tap the frost spirits before they reach you.

r7.hint.t: Follow the glow. It shows the next step.

hint.done.t: This room is done. Go on to the next one.

r1.plaque.t: The plaque says Aldric is first and Doreth is last. Cadoc comes after Berenor.

r1.step1.t: Good. Now we know every king and his shield. Look up at the four sockets above the gate and tap them.

r2.tree1.t: Rule one: begin on a leaf and end on a star.

r2.tree2.t: Rule two: never step on a thorn.

r2.tree3.t: Rule three: the next stone must not match the stone you leave.

r2.tree4.t: Rule four: never lean the same way twice in a row.

r2.step1.t: That is all four rules. Now tap the stepping stones and pick your path.

r3.plates.t: Four recipes. Swords and shields, plain or fine. Each one uses iron and darksteel.

r3.slate.t: Four swords and three shields. Use every bar. At least three swords must be fine.

r3.step1.t: Now we know the order. Tap the anvil and build it. The counter helps.

r4.cards.t: Four cards: a name, the frost, trade and an oath. Each lord needs a different one.

r4.step1.t: Now tap the table. Pick a lord, then tap the line that fits what that lord cares about.

r5.raven.t: The raven shows who attacks and from which side. Build the right defenders, then start the wave.

r6.map.t: The map is whole. The road lengths are in your Book. Now read the notes on the wall.

r6.notes.t: Each host has a speed. Everyone must arrive on Day 7.

r6.step2.t: Days on the road are the road divided by the speed. A host leaves on day 7 minus its days. Tap the rail.

r4.clue.venn.t: That painting is Lord Venn himself. And every cup says VENN FIRST.

r4.clue.orne.t: Lady Orne's wall is all locks and bolts. And she keeps grain for three winters.

r4.clue.keyes.t: Lord Keyes has towers of ledgers, a coin scale and a toll chart of the Raven Road.

r4.clue.crane.t: Lady Crane keeps an oath-sword over her hearth, and a framed oath to the old king.

r5.w1.t: Thralls at the north and west gates. Weak, but many. Oil pots burn them all at once.

r5.w2.t: The Frost Host! Thralls from the north, trolls from the east, wraiths from the south. Hold the wall!

oaths.name: Ravenspire
oaths.gives: Ravens that read where a host marches
oaths.title: Oath of Ravenspire

ashfall: The gate was opened from inside at the ninth bell. The bar was lifted, not broken.
No beacon burned that night. The Wood saw only darkness.
The armory was opened with a key. No door was forced.
A raven told the northern lords to stand down at the eighth bell.
The wall watch was called to the feast hall at sundown.
The order to hold the north pass was cancelled with the king's own seal.

rooms.name: Gatehouse of Eldoria
rooms.goal: Study the four statues and the plaque. Then put the crests in the sockets above the gate.

objective.text: Look at the four statues and read the plaque.
Put the four crests in the sockets above the gate.
The gate is open. Go through.

hotspots.label: Statue
hotspots.title: Aldric the Bold

views.t: A faceless king. The nameplate says: ALDRIC THE BOLD.

hotspots.note: Aldric the Bold: shield with a lion.

hotspots.label: Statue
hotspots.title: Berenor the Wise

views.t: A faceless king. The nameplate says: BERENOR THE WISE.
His shield shows an oak tree.

hotspots.note: Berenor the Wise: shield with an oak tree.

hotspots.label: Statue
hotspots.title: Cadoc the Just

views.t: A faceless king. The nameplate says: CADOC THE JUST.

hotspots.note: Cadoc the Just: shield with a mountain.

hotspots.label: Statue
hotspots.title: Doreth the Swift

views.t: A faceless king. The nameplate says: DORETH THE SWIFT.

hotspots.note: Doreth the Swift: shield with a hawk.

hotspots.label: Plaque
hotspots.title: The bronze plaque
hotspots.text: "Aldric raised the gate and the sun. Doreth shut it, last of the line. Cadoc came after Berenor."
hotspots.note: Plaque: Aldric raised the gate and the sun. Doreth shut it, last of the line. Cadoc came after Berenor.

rooms.name: Silverwood
rooms.goal: Read the four carved trees. Then find the safe path across the stepping stones.

objective.text: Read the rules carved on the four great trees.
Cross the stepping stones. Follow all four rules.
The Wood has let you through.

hotspots.label: Tree
hotspots.title: Tree of the Bough
hotspots.text: Carved in the bark: "Begin on a leaf and end on a star."
hotspots.note: Tree rule 1: begin on a leaf and end on a star.

hotspots.label: Tree
hotspots.title: Thorn Tree
hotspots.text: Carved in the bark: "Do not step on the thorn."
hotspots.note: Tree rule 2: never step on a thorn.

hotspots.label: Tree
hotspots.title: Moon Tree
hotspots.text: Carved in the bark: "No stone may match the stone you leave."
hotspots.note: Tree rule 3: the next stone must not match the stone you leave.

hotspots.label: Tree
hotspots.title: The Willow
hotspots.text: Carved in the bark: "Do not lean the same way twice in a row." (Two steps left in a row, or two steps right in a row, are not allowed.)
hotspots.note: Tree rule 4: never lean left twice or right twice in a row.

rooms.name: Ironroot Forge
rooms.goal: Read the recipes and the order slate. Then fill the order on the anvil. The panel counts for you.

objective.text: Read the recipes and the order slate.
Fill the order on the anvil. Use every bar.
The forge sings.

hotspots.label: Recipes
hotspots.title: Four recipe plates
hotspots.text:
Plain sword: 3 iron.
Fine sword: 2 iron + 1 darksteel.
Plain shield: 5 iron.
Banded shield: 3 iron + 2 darksteel.
hotspots.note: Recipes: plain sword 3 iron. Fine sword 2 iron + 1 darksteel. Plain shield 5 iron. Banded shield 3 iron + 2 darksteel.

hotspots.label: Order slate
hotspots.title: The order slate
hotspots.text: "Four swords and three shields. Use every bar and every ingot. At least three swords must be fine."
hotspots.note: Order: 4 swords and 3 shields. Use all ore. At least 3 swords fine.

rooms.name: Ravenspire Council
rooms.goal: Look at the thing near each lord. Read the cards. Then give each lord the line that fits what they care about.

objective.text: Look at one thing near each lord. Then read the cards on the table.
At the table, give each lord the line that moves them.
The council has said yes.

hotspots.label: Portrait
hotspots.title: A gold-framed portrait

views.t: Venn: a huge painting of himself, and cups all engraved VENN FIRST.

hotspots.note: Venn: a huge painting of himself, and cups all engraved VENN FIRST.

hotspots.label: Locks
hotspots.title: Wall of locks

views.t: Orne: a wall of locks, barred windows, and grain stored for three winters.

hotspots.note: Orne: a wall of locks, barred windows, and grain stored for three winters.

hotspots.label: Ledgers
hotspots.title: Towers of ledgers

views.t: Keyes: towers of ledgers, a coin scale and a toll chart of the Raven Road.

hotspots.note: Keyes: towers of ledgers, a coin scale and a toll chart of the Raven Road.

hotspots.label: Oath-sword
hotspots.title: Oath-sword

views.t: Crane: an oath-sword over the hearth and a framed oath to the old king.

hotspots.note: Crane: an oath-sword over the hearth and a framed oath to the old king.

hotspots.label: Cards
hotspots.title: The argument cards
hotspots.text: Four argument cards lie on the table: one about a name, one about the frost, one about trade, one about an oath. Each lord will hear all four, in a different order. Pick the one that fits what that lord cares about.
hotspots.note: Four argument cards: a name, the frost, trade, an oath. Pick the one that fits each lord.

rooms.name: Stormwatch Wall
rooms.goal: Read the raven's report. Build defenders on the wall. Beat the two waves. If the wall falls, you can try again.

objective.text: Read the raven's report. It names the side and the enemy.
Build defenders on the wall. Then start the wave.

rooms.name: Highmere War Room
rooms.goal: Rebuild the map. Read the marching notes. Then send each host out on the right day.

objective.text: Put the six map pieces back together on the table.
Read the marching notes on the wall.
Place each host's banner on the day it should leave.
The hosts march.

hotspots.label: Notes
hotspots.title: The marching notes
hotspots.text:
Speeds, in leagues per day:
Stormvale 6. Ironroot 3. Aelari 8. Ravenspire 10. Valorin Guard 5.

The frost reaches Highmere at dawn on Day 7. A host that leaves on day D and needs T days arrives at dawn on day D + T. All five hosts must arrive on Day 7.
hotspots.note: Speeds: Stormvale 6, Ironroot 3, Aelari 8, Ravenspire 10, Valorin Guard 5 leagues a day. A host leaving on day D needing T days arrives on day D+T. Everyone must arrive on Day 7.

rooms.name: The Ashen Throne
rooms.goal: Sound the Horn of Highmere. Then find the traitor. Then break the frost.

objective.text: Tap the glowing Horn of Highmere.
Test each Ashfall fact on the suspects. Accuse the traitor.
Tap the frost spirits before they reach you.
Make the last choice.

rules: Begin on a leaf and end on a star.
Do not step on a thorn.
No stone may match the one you leave.
Do not lean the same way twice in a row.

cards.A: Your name will be carved above the throne.
cards.B: The frost will reach Ravenspire next. Together we can stop it.
cards.C: Reopen the Raven Road. Ten years with no tax.
cards.D: You swore to serve the Valorin crown. That oath did not die with the king.

defenders.name: Archer
defenders.info: 2 damage each volley. Hits ground and air.

defenders.name: Oil pot
defenders.info: 3 damage to every ground enemy on its side, once. Ground only.

take.title: The Throne Taken
beats: Elowen sits on the Ashen Throne.
The frost leaves the hall, but not her breath.
The five banners kneel. Maelor bows.
A raven lands. It carries a letter sealed with a pale queen's mark.

break.title: The Throne Broken
beats: Vyrmrath breathes fire on the Ashen Throne.
Five banners hang side by side. Elowen says no king will sit alone again.
Far to the north, a veiled queen smiles on a frozen balcony.

spare.title: The Hollow King Freed
beats: Elowen frees the Hollow King. His crown fades to dust.
His face returns. He is Prince Malachar, once bound by the Veiled Queen.
He tells her where the Veiled Queen waits. Then he walks north into the dark.
A line of frost begins to move south again.

endings.choiceText: The frost is gone from his face. He is Prince Malachar, once a Valorin, bound by the Veiled Queen. What will you do?

choices.label: Break the throne
choices.sub: End the age of lonely kings.

timeup.title: The Long Winter covers the realm.

ui.hintNoRenown: Not enough {0} to use a hint.
ui.saved: Saved to your Book. You will need it for the puzzle.
ui.socketHint: Put the kings' crests in order, I to IV. The plaque says who comes first and last. Drag a crest into a socket, or tap a crest, then a socket.
ui.socketWrong: The gate does not move. The crests slip back.
ui.stoneHint: Tap a stone in each row, from the bottom up. Dim stones break a rule, so you cannot pick them. If you get stuck, tap your last stone to step back.
ui.stoneWrong: The roots snap back! You are back on the bank.
ui.forgeHint: Make exactly what the slate asks. Use every bar and ingot. The counter shows how you are doing.
ui.forge_over: You do not have that much ore.
ui.forge_under: Some ore is left over. The order needs every bar.
ui.forge_count: The scale tips. Check the number of swords and shields, and the fine swords.
ui.councilHint: 1. Tap a lord. 2. Read the four lines. 3. Tap the line that fits what that lord cares about.
ui.lordWon: This lord has already said yes.
ui.mapHint: Put the six pieces in the right places. Drag them, or tap a piece and then a square.
ui.mapNote: The map is restored. Road lengths are in the Map page.
ui.mapRestored: The map is whole! Road lengths saved to your Book.
ui.pieceNo: That piece does not go there.
ui.dispatchHint: Each host needs some days on the road. All must arrive on Day 7. So a host leaves on day 7 minus its days. Drag each banner to its day.
ui.hornWon: A horn note and a fact are saved to your Book.
ui.hornHint: The song is filled in as you win each room.
ui.readRaven: Tap the glowing raven to read the report.
ui.held: The wave is beaten. The wall holds.
ui.keepRing: Keep Vyrmrath inside the ring, then sound the next note.
ui.lookLeft: The dragon is to your left.
ui.lookRight: The dragon is to your right.
ui.courtHint: Each king says what they saw. Under it is the record of Ashfall. Find the one king whose words do not match the record, then tap Accuse. Tap a king's words to hear them.
ui.stoneStuck: No safe stone here. Tap your last stone to step back.
ui.forgeTotals: Swords {0}/4 · Shields {1}/3 · Fine swords {2} (need 3 or more)
ui.pickLord: Tap a lord to see what you noticed and hear four lines.
ui.ravenTip: Tip: oil pots burn swarms of thralls. Ballistae shoot trolls. Archers shoot flyers.
ui.hornLine: The horn sounds a new note: {0}.
ui.resBreach: Wave beaten, but the wall was hit!
ui.resNext: Next: read the raven's report, then build your defenders again.
ui.resFinalLine: Both waves are beaten. Captain Hild has something to say.
ui.resLostLine: The frost broke through. Build differently and try again.
ui.buildTip: Pick a defender below, then tap a slot on the wall. Tap a filled slot to remove it.
ui.trailHint: These five things happened on Ashfall night. Tap a fact to test it on the three suspects. A tick means they could do it. A cross means they could not.
ui.trailAll: All tested. Only one person has a tick every time. Accuse them.
ui.trailLeft: {0} left to test. You can accuse when you are sure.
ui.s3tip: Follow the arrow and tap the frost spirits before they reach you.

suspects.name: Marshal Oswin
suspects.role: Leads the armies. Slept in the war room tower.

suspects.name: Captain Hild
suspects.role: Leads the wall watch. Stood on the Frostwall.

suspects.name: High Steward Varric
suspects.role: Runs the castle. Keeps the keys, the seal and the ravens.

why.hild: She was outside, on the wall.

why.oswin: He only has the war room key.

why.hild: Her raven only flies to the wall.

why.oswin: He does not lead the watch.
